question:
**Match the following definitions with their one-word substitutions.**

 
 

 A.
 One who dies without a will. 
 (i)
 Itinerant
 
 

 B.
 Far away from other places. 
 (ii)
 Intestate
 
 

 C
 To supply land with water by artificial means. 
 (iii)
 Isolated
 
 

 D.
 Travelling from place to place, especially to find work. 
 (iv)
 Irrigate
solution:
The correct answer is " **A-(ii), B-(iii), C-(iv), D-(i)"**
